name: 15423-sharegpt-bamba9b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine.
architecture: BambaForCausalLM, a 9.8e9-parameter hybrid decoder: 32 layers, of which 3 are self-attention (indices 9, 18, 27) and 29 are Mamba2 state-space blocks. Read off the checkpoint's config.json.
load_profile: concurrent, streams=1000 against 1000 requests, no warmup, 900 s safety cap -- all 1000 requests are in flight from t=0, which is what the source's `benchmark_serving.py` default `--request-rate inf --num-prompts 1000` does. 256 are admitted (max_num_seqs) and the other 744 wait: the queue depth behind the source's 88.3 s mean TTFT.
workload: the source's own ShareGPT V3 sample, replayed. `configs/data/sharegpt-bamba-1000.jsonl` is `ShareGPTDataset.sample()` from the engine checkout's own benchmarks/benchmark_dataset.py transcribed (seed 0, entries with >=2 turns, shuffle, first 1000 passing is_valid_sequence) and tokenized with Bamba's own tokenizer. It sums to 215201 input and 198343 output tokens -- the source's published totals, to the token. Each request is forced to its own output length (per-row `output_tokens_count` becomes max_tokens + ignore_eos), matching `--ignore-eos`. A real distribution, not a point mass: prompts 4..997, outputs 4..863. The prompt is sent raw (`request_format: plain`, greedy), which is the `/v1/completions` payload the source's client sent.
purpose: A general-purpose chat assistant on a 9-billion-parameter hybrid model, serving 1000 varied conversations at once on one GPU.
launch:
# The engine's command line: vLLM at commit 5fbab20e021a4febbeda830eaa15a2deb598c01e, V0 path.
# Several of these are defaults written out rather than inherited, because this engine derives
# them from the context length the checkpoint declares and that declaration has since changed.
# They are the declared operating point, not a tuning choice: do not sweep them.

model: ibm-ai-platform/Bamba-9B
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: float16
max-model-len: 4096
enable-chunked-prefill: true
max-num-batched-tokens: 2048
max-num-seqs: 256
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.9
